description: Query Ciel des peuples: how 9 named nations (Diné, Pawnee, Inca, Maya, Mexica, Polynesia...) read the sky, with asterisms, coordinates, sources, and what is attested versus interpreted or kept private. Filter by nation, by a western constellation to compare cultures, by theme, or by free text; give lat to know which objects never rise there. Use it for cultural astronomy; for what is in the sky tonight use tonight_sky. Local curated data, no network call; never uses the generic 'the Indians'.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Optional observer latitude, to flag objects that never rise there.

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

nation.description: Nation slug or name, e.g. dine (or navajo), pawnee, inca, maya, mexica, polynesie.

q.description: Free-text search over names and captions, e.g. 'pléiades', 'vénus'.

theme.description: Restrict to one use of the sky.

western.description: Western constellation or asterism to compare across nations, e.g. orion, pleiades.

name: first_skies

outputSchema.description: Returns n_nations or nation detail {slug, objects, sections, ethics}, or search hits.

title: Indigenous sky knowledge (Ciel des peuples)
